body: Three specific gaps. (1) The Gaussian mechanism is not calibrated by ε alone: the analytic Gaussian mechanism requires a privacy parameter δ as well, so the acceptance scenario 'Gaussian noise calibrated to ε=5.0' is under-specified — without a stated δ (and the corresponding σ = sqrt(2 ln(1.25/δ)) Δ/ε scaling), the Gaussian arm of the experiment is not reproducible and the Laplace/Gaussian comparison is not well-defined. (2) The GLM in User Story 3 treats individual interval inclusions as binomial trials, but the design has very few independent units (three datasets); inclusions within a dataset are clustered, so the p-values for ε and noise type will be anti-conservative unless the model accounts for this clustering or the unit of analysis is the dataset-level coverage rate. (3) The nominal target is left as '[deferred]' in the acceptance scenarios and SC-001 even though 95% is fixed in User Story 1 and FR-003; deferring a quantity already pinned elsewhere invites inconsistency, and FR-006's threshold sweep (90/93/95) presupposes it.
